name: Boxcrest
tagline: The operating system for branded merchandise programs.
positioning: Boxcrest gives owner-operators one governed platform to source, warehouse, and distribute company swag without the spreadsheet chaos.

hero.h1: Corporate swag, operated like real infrastructure.
hero.sub: Boxcrest replaces the reorder spreadsheet, the closet full of unclaimed hoodies, and the vendor email thread with a single governed platform your whole team runs from.

features.title: Governed swag catalog
features.description: Publish an approved catalog with locked logos, colors, and budgets so no manager ever orders off-brand mugs at 11pm again.

features.title: On-demand kit fulfillment
features.description: Trigger new-hire, event, and client-gift kits from one dashboard. We warehouse the inventory and ship the moment a request clears.

features.title: Spend controls per seat
features.description: Assign per-seat budgets and approval rules so owner-operators keep merchandise spend inside plan without policing every request.

features.title: Live inventory ledger
features.description: Track every unit across warehouses in real time, with low-stock alerts before your flagship quarter-zips run out.

features.title: Recipient address capture
features.description: Send a secure link and let recipients enter their own shipping details, eliminating the address-collection thread entirely.

features.title: Program reporting
features.description: Export spend, redemption, and unit-cost reports your accountant will actually accept at close.

testimonials.quote: We used to store branded gear in a supply closet and guess at reorders. Boxcrest turned our swag into a line item we can forecast. New-hire kits ship themselves now.
testimonials.name: Marissa Kell

testimonials.quote: As the owner, I was the bottleneck on every logo approval. The governed catalog gave my managers a lane, and I stopped getting texts about polo colors.
testimonials.name: Devon Achebe

testimonials.quote: Client gifting was a two-week scramble every December. With per-seat budgets and address capture, our account team runs it in an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

homepage.footerBlurb: Boxcrest is the branded merchandise platform for owner-operators who want their swag governed, warehoused, and accountable.
